results.title: Certificate consistency
results.question: Review the design certificate for internal consistency. Identify any date, reference or supporting-document detail that appears unusual, inconsistent or requires verification. Do not assume it is correct merely because it appears on a certificate.
details: A design cannot normally rely on a report dated after the drawings it certifies. The date may be a typo, or the report may not be the one used. This is a concern to investigate, not proof the certificate is invalid.
Without an issue date it cannot be confirmed that the certificate was issued for, and after, the current drawing revision.
